content:
BUILTCoLAB was present at the Science Meeting 2020 that took place on 03 and 04 November, an initiative of FCT with the support of Ciência Viva – National Agency for Scientific and Technological Culture and the Parliamentary Committee of Education and Science.

BUILT was present in one of the virtual sessions dynamic by ANI within the PERIN/Horizonte Europa network and collaborative laboratories (CoLAB), dedicated to the theme “Materials, Circular Economy and Urban Sustainability”. Paulo Fonseca, our Executive Director, had the opportunity to present the guidelines of our Collaborative Laboratory.
